reasons: All six preferred atomic elements (CGL per-occurrence and aggregate, E&O 2M, cyber 5M with the processing condition demonstrably present, workers' comp, certificates on request) are expressly met by the inserted Insurance section, so the locked preferred level is complete.
The insertion adds a one-year post-termination coverage tail that the preferred position does not require, going beyond what is needed to complete the level; a term-only obligation would suffice.
"at its own expense" is likewise surplus boilerplate not called for by the position.

Intent is preserved: the risk-of-loss, contact-information and territory paragraphs are untouched, the new section is anchored as a standalone heading before the next section, and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
Recommend deleting the tail and the expense phrase; otherwise no substantive redline is warranted.
